description: Mathematics matriculation 2018: topic → subtopic → concept/keywords index mapped to question ids and textbook pages. Used by the offline search tutor.

topics.title: Sets
topics.concept: Sets are described by listing or set-builder notation; union, intersection, complement, difference and Cartesian product; Venn diagrams.

subtopics.title: Set operations and identities
subtopics.concept: A ∪ B, A ∩ B, A′ = U − A, A − B = A ∩ B′. Laws: De Morgan (A ∪ B)′ = A′ ∩ B′, absorption A ∩ (A ∪ B) = A, A ∪ A′ = U, A ∩ A′ = ∅. Check identities with a Venn diagram or a counter-example.

topics.title: Relations and functions
topics.unit: G9 Unit 2; G10 Unit 1 – Foundations for Functions; G11 Units 2–3
topics.concept: Functions as sets of ordered pairs or rules; domain and range; one-to-one functions and inverses; operations on functions; absolute value.

subtopics.title: Function operations, one-to-one functions and inverses
subtopics.concept: (f ± g)(x) = f(x) ± g(x) on the common domain. f is one-to-one if f(x₁) = f(x₂) ⇒ x₁ = x₂ (horizontal line test). To find f⁻¹ interchange x and y and solve; f⁻¹(b) is the x with f(x) = b; domain of f⁻¹ = range of f.

textbook_refs.section: 1.1.2 Functions (functions as sets of ordered pairs)

subtopics.title: Absolute value and radicals
subtopics.concept: |a| = a if a ≥ 0, −a if a < 0. |a + b| ≤ |a| + |b| with equality iff ab ≥ 0. Decide the sign before removing the bars.

subtopics.title: Linear equations and modelling
subtopics.concept: Translate words into equations ('is' → =). Solve by collecting like terms; check the solution.

textbook_refs.section: 2.2.2 Solving Linear Equations with Variables on Both Sides

topics.title: Linear functions, lines and systems
topics.unit: G9 Unit 3 – Linear Functions; G12 3.2 Straight Lines; G12 Unit 4
topics.concept: Slope, intercepts and equations of lines; parallel (equal slopes) and perpendicular (m₁m₂ = −1) lines; systems of linear equations.

subtopics.title: Lines: slope, parallel and perpendicular
subtopics.concept: Slope of Ax + By + C = 0 is −A/B. Parallel ⇔ equal slopes (Ab = aB); perpendicular ⇔ m₁m₂ = −1 (Aa + Bb = 0). Point-slope form y − y₁ = m(x − x₁).

subtopics.title: Systems of linear equations
subtopics.concept: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂ → infinitely many solutions; a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂ → none; otherwise exactly one. Solve by elimination, substitution, graphs or Cramer's rule.

textbook_refs.section: 4.2 Solving System of Equations Using Determinant

topics.title: Quadratic and polynomial functions
topics.unit: G9 Units 4, 8; G11 Unit 1 – Polynomial Function
topics.concept: Graphs of quadratics (vertex, opening, range, shifts), quadratic equations and inequalities, polynomial division and graphs.

subtopics.title: Graphs of quadratic functions
subtopics.concept: y = ax² + bx + c: vertex x = −b/(2a); a > 0 → minimum, a < 0 → maximum, extreme value c − b²/(4a). y = a(x − h)² + k is y = ax² shifted h right and k up.

textbook_refs.section: 4.3 Effects of Parametric Changes of Quadratic Functions

subtopics.title: Quadratic equations and inequalities
subtopics.concept: Solve by factorization or the formula; discriminant Δ = b² − 4ac (Δ = 0: one repeated root). Sum of roots −b/a, product c/a. Inequalities: sign chart; if a > 0 and Δ < 0 the quadratic is always positive.

subtopics.title: Polynomials: division, roots and graphs
subtopics.concept: Degree n ⇒ at most n real roots. Even degree: range bounded on one side; odd degree: at least one real root. Long division: dividend = divisor × quotient + remainder, deg R < deg divisor.

topics.title: Rational expressions, equations and functions
topics.concept: Simplify rational expressions, solve rational equations and inequalities, find asymptotes and intercepts of rational functions.

subtopics.title: Rational expressions, equations, inequalities and graphs
subtopics.concept: Excluded values make a denominator zero. Vertical asymptotes at zeros of the denominator (not cancelled); horizontal asymptote y = 0 if deg N < deg D. Rational inequalities: sign chart with zeros of numerator and denominator.

textbook_refs.section: 3.3.3 Multiplication and Division of Rational Expressions
2.2.2 Solving Linear Equations with Variables on Both Sides

topics.title: Exponents and logarithms
topics.unit: G9 Unit 5; G11 Unit 4 – Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
topics.concept: Laws of exponents and logarithms, exponential and logarithmic equations and inequalities, graphs of exponential functions.

subtopics.title: Exponents, logarithms and their functions
subtopics.concept: aˣ = aʸ ⇒ x = y. logₐx = ln x/ln a (change of base); logₐb·log(base b)c = logₐc. y = aˣ⁺ʰ + k has domain ℝ, range (k, ∞) and asymptote y = k.

topics.title: Sequences and series
topics.concept: Recursive and explicit sequences, arithmetic and geometric progressions, infinite geometric series.

subtopics.title: Arithmetic and geometric progressions, series
subtopics.concept: AP: aₙ = a₁ + (n − 1)d, 2b = a + c. GP: aₙ = a₁rⁿ⁻¹. Infinite GP with |r| < 1: S = a₁/(1 − r).

textbook_refs.section: 1.1 Basic Ideas of Sequence (recursively defined sequences)

topics.title: Statistics and probability
topics.unit: G12 Unit 2 – Descriptive Statistics and Probability
topics.concept: Mean, median, mode, range, variance and standard deviation; probability of events.

subtopics.title: Measures of central tendency and dispersion
subtopics.concept: Order the data for the median. Variance σ² = Σ(xᵢ − x̄)²/N. Adding a constant shifts the mean but not the spread; multiplying by c multiplies the SD by |c|.

subtopics.title: Probability
subtopics.concept: P(E) = favourable/total equally likely outcomes. n coin tosses: 2ⁿ outcomes, C(n, k) with exactly k heads.

topics.title: Matrices and determinants
topics.concept: Operations on 2×2 matrices, determinants, inverses and Cramer's rule.

subtopics.title: Determinants of 2×2 matrices
subtopics.concept: det(a b; c d) = ad − bc. A matrix is invertible iff det ≠ 0.

topics.title: Business mathematics
topics.unit: G9 Unit 7; G11 Unit 6 – Business Mathematics
topics.concept: Percentages, profit and loss, commission, simple and compound interest, instalment plans.

subtopics.title: Percentage, profit, commission, interest and instalments
subtopics.concept: Profit % is on cost price (include transport). Commission = rate × sales. Compound: A = P(1 + r/k)ᵏᵗ. Instalment price = down payment + sum of instalments.

topics.title: Plane geometry
topics.unit: G9 Unit 6; G10 Units 2–3, 5; G11 Unit 5
topics.concept: Axiomatic reasoning, circle theorems, similar triangles and trigonometric laws.

subtopics.title: Axioms, conjectures, theorems and proofs
subtopics.concept: Axiom: accepted without proof. Conjecture: generalisation from observations, not yet proved. Theorem: proved statement.

subtopics.title: Angles, chords and tangents of circles
subtopics.concept: Chords meeting inside: angle = ½(sum of arcs); outside: ½(difference). Tangent ⟂ radius; tangent–chord angle = ½ arc; tangents from a point are equal; angle in a semicircle = 90°.

textbook_refs.section: 3.3.2 Intersection of a Tangent Line and a Chord

subtopics.title: Similar triangles
subtopics.concept: AA, SAS, SSS similarity; corresponding sides proportional. Useful result: for AB, CD, EF ⟂ BF with C = AF ∩ BE, 1/CD = 1/AB + 1/EF.

textbook_refs.unit: Unit 5 – Similarity and the Geometry of Shape
Unit 5 – Similarity and the Geometry of Shape

subtopics.title: Trigonometric ratios and the laws of sines and cosines
subtopics.concept: Law of cosines: b² = a² + c² − 2ac cos B ⇒ cos B = (a² + c² − b²)/(2ac).

textbook_refs.unit: Unit 6 – Right Angled Triangle and Trigonometric Ratios

topics.title: Coordinate geometry and transformations
topics.unit: G10 Unit 4 – Dimensionality and Geometry of Location; G12 Unit 3
topics.concept: Distance and midpoint formulas, equations of lines and circles, reflections and translations.

subtopics.title: Distance, midpoint and equations of lines
subtopics.concept: d = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²); midpoint ((x₁ + x₂)/2, (y₁ + y₂)/2). Perpendicular bisector: through the midpoint with slope −1/m.

textbook_refs.unit: Unit 4 – Dimensionality and Geometry of Location
Unit 4 – Dimensionality and Geometry of Location

subtopics.title: Equation of a circle; lines and circles
subtopics.concept: (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r². Compare the distance d from the centre to the line with r: d > r none, d = r tangent, d < r two points.
keywords: distance from a point to a line

subtopics.title: Translations and reflections
subtopics.concept: A translation adds a fixed vector. Reflection in y = x + c: (x, y) → (y − c, x + c); the mirror line is the perpendicular bisector of PP′.

textbook_refs.unit: Unit 4 – Dimensionality and Geometry of Location
Unit 4 – Dimensionality and Geometry of Location

topics.title: Perimeter, area, surface area and volume
topics.unit: G10 Unit 5 – Congruency and the Geometry of Size
topics.concept: Perimeters and areas of polygons and sectors; surface areas and volumes of prisms, cylinders, cones and spheres.

subtopics.title: Perimeter, area, surface area and volume
subtopics.concept: Regular hexagon in a circle: side = r. Sector area = (θ/360°)πr². Cone LSA = πrl with l = √(r² + h²); cylinder LSA = 2πrh. Cube: space diagonal a√3, V = a³.
